identityFallbackEvidence.parentBrandOff: Returns the exact context legacy identity before evaluating runtime or bundled state.
identityFallbackEvidence.bundledAssetUnavailable: Returns the exact context legacy identity when bundledIdentityReady is false or any selected bundled export is absent.
identityFallbackEvidence.separateNearoOwnership: Nearo receipt and checkout contexts remain Nearo even when the Oorva parent brand is enabled.
identityFallbackEvidence.publishedSchema: Accepts schema version 1 (or the already-validated provider projection without an explicit version); rejects an explicitly unsupported version and falls back to legacy even if bundled assets are ready.
identityFallbackEvidence.noPlaceholderIdentity: Bundled logo rendering uses only selected local exports; legacy and published identities retain their exact display label when no renderable bundled export applies.
identityFallbackEvidence.financialIdentityFields: Issuer, account identifiers, receipt snapshots, contact URLs, historical text, payout narration, and technical identifiers are not part of the identity API.

testCoverage: All legacy contexts with brand OFF and bundled assets unavailable
Parent brand OFF despite runtime and bundled state being ON
Separately owned Nearo receipt and checkout contexts remain Nearo
Selected O01X exports match manifest paths, real roles, SHA-256 values, and O01X evidence
Published identity display fields, null assets, invalid schema, and safe fallback
BrandLogo uses the selected dark export or the exact identity label without a placeholder
